paragraphs: The Z4 has been produced since 2002, and the 2.5i and 2.5si variants were part of the first-generation E85/E86 roadster range. The 2.5i used a naturally aspirated straight-six petrol engine, while the later 2.5si received an updated version of the same engine family. Both variants shared the same core architecture but differed in power output and certain internal components.
about.boldParagraph: The Z4 Z4 2.5i  2.5si is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the Z4 2.5i and 2.5si are mechanically different despite sharing the same displacement, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming parts are interchangeable — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
